Package dev.oumaimaa.kawaiiapi.colors

Class ColorTranslator

java.lang.Object
dev.oumaimaa.kawaiiapi.colors.ColorTranslator
public final class ColorTranslator extends Object
Modern utility class for translating color codes in strings to Minecraft-compatible formats. Supports legacy color codes (&), hex colors (invalid input: '&#'RRGGBB), and MiniMessage format.

Uses Adventure API exclusively for maximum compatibility with Paper 1.21+.

Version:
1.0
Author:
KawaiiDevelopment
